description: Réseau routier géré par la Région wallonne is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Service public de Wallonie Mobilité et Infrastructures. the road network of the Walloon Region, consisting of highways, regional roads (commonly called "Nationales"), highway and road rings, interchange branches, bretelles, managed by the SPW MI. Coverage: the Walloon Region (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are RTTI. The portal shows 2026-03-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
